title: spec.json
description: The generated artifact produced by specgen and ingested by contract consumers. Indexed by symbol-id.

linkRef.description: An anchored repository-local reference defined by spec/link-ref.md.

text.description: The temporary measure owned by this symbol.

until.description: The verifiable condition for removal or replacement; not an automatic expiry.

id.description: Optional authored identity within one symbol. Required and unique when that symbol carries multiple specs.

spec.description: The contract preamble in natural language. May be absent when only cases, whys, ideals, tmps, links, or rules exist.

links.description: Author-curated anchored see-also references for this spec.

rules.description: Review criteria attached to this spec.

whys.description: Structured rationale that explains why the symbol uses its current design, ordering, or boundary. It may exist without a spec.

tmps.description: Temporary measures with explicit exit conditions; may exist without a spec.

ideals.description: The ideal shape this symbol should converge toward when current constraints no longer apply. It is not a roadmap commitment and may exist without a spec.

fqn.description: The symbol's language-native fully-qualified name when the toolchain can resolve one reliably.

specs.description: Contracts bound to this code symbol.
